item.title: NYS comptroller warns of budget deficit, health insurance risks
item.description: New York State's proposed budget for 2027 faces a potential $27.5 billion deficit by 2030 due to federal cuts, which could result in 1 million New Yorkers losing health insurance, but the state's $3.5 billion surplus could help prevent these cuts.

item.title: Alysa Liu wins first women's figure skating gold medal for the US in 24 years
item.description: Alysa Liu delivered the U.S. its first women’s figure skating Olympic gold medal in 24 years, performing a near-flawless free skate on Thursday night in a glittering golden dress to upstage Japanese rivals Kaori Sakamoto and Ami Nakai at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: Governor Hochul proposes tax on nicotine pouches
item.description: According to a 2025 World Health Organization report, one in five adults, globally, are addicted to tobacco. Governor Hochul proposed in her Executive Budget for FY 2027 to broaden the tobacco products’ definition to include nicotine. This would cause nicotine pouch products such as Zyn, Velo, and On! to carry a 75% wholesale tax.

item.title: More than 320K Nissan vehicles recalled over defect that could lead to crash
item.description: More than 320,000 vehicles manufactured by Nissan North America, Inc. have been recalled due to an engine failure risk, according to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
